frozen_before.note: no feature, transformation, weight or window below may be changed after this date without incrementing spec_id and re-freezing; a changed spec makes the 5 Nov observation exploratory, not prospective

audit_finding: A03 (window sensitivity, multiple testing, data vintage)

primary_targets.name: nights_surprise_pct
primary_targets.why_not: ABNB gives no numeric nights guide; nights guidance is qualitative

primary_targets.name: open_5d_pct
primary_targets.definition: ABNB minus QQQ, OPEN of the reaction session to the close of the 5th session (reaction session = 1)

primary_targets.name: open_20d_pct
primary_targets.definition: same, to the close of the 20th session

baseline_note: trailing4_mean and trailing8_mean are mandatory. The full expanding mean of a surprise series beginning in 2021 is dominated by the COVID-rebound surprises (+16.1%, +24.2%), so any model that is effectively an intercept shift beats it trivially. pred_sd_over_actual_sd in 20_task_summary.csv flags such models.

primary_candidate_features.name: f_surprise_trail4
primary_candidate_features.transform: mean of the same surprise over t-4..t-1

primary_candidate_features.name: f_guide_vs_street_lag1
primary_candidate_features.transform: guide midpoint vs Street for quarter t, as published at print t-1

primary_candidate_features.name: pr_hotel_revpar_yoy_pit
primary_candidate_features.transform: mean RevPAR y/y of MAR and HLT, restricted to the peers whose report date precedes the ABNB print
primary_candidate_features.available_at_cutoff: 1-15 days before the print, when a peer reported first

primary_candidate_features.name: bl_funds_yoy_lag1
primary_candidate_features.transform: y/y of funds held for clients at end of t-1

primary_candidate_features.name: eu_platform_yoy_lag1
primary_candidate_features.transform: y/y of Eurostat EU27 platform nights for t-1

primary_candidate_features.name: ia_reviews_ltm_matched_yoy
primary_candidate_features.transform: y/y of matched-listing LTM reviews across the fixed Inside Airbnb city set
primary_candidate_features.available_at_cutoff: dump date, 1-8 weeks before the print

weights: equal; single-feature OLS with an intercept. No feature weighting, no feature selection inside the evaluation loop, no shrinkage, no interaction terms.
fitting_scheme: expanding window, chronological; the fit for event t uses only events strictly earlier than t
missing_data_policy: listwise. An event with a missing feature or a missing label is skipped, never imputed and never forward-filled. Every table reports n after filters. A quarter with no Inside Airbnb dump or no Common Crawl crawl stays missing.

evaluation_windows.rule: both windows are reported for every headline. Never pair n from one window with a ratio from another.

entry_convention_for_return_targets: OPEN of the first session after the release. The pre-release close is not transactable with knowledge of the released numbers and is reported only as 'legacy'.
decision_rule: a feature is reported as adding value only if its walk-forward RMSE is below EVERY allowed baseline for that target, on identical events, in BOTH windows.

multiple_testing.primary_tests_planned: 8 features x 2 surprise targets + 3 features x 2 return targets = 22 primary model/target pairs, each reported in 3 windows
multiple_testing.note: no p-value in this specification is corrected for multiplicity; a single surviving pair out of 22 is what one expects by chance at a 5% threshold. The out-of-sample RMSE ratio, not a p-value, is the decision rule.

exploratory_ledger.status: EXPLORATORY. 598 alt-data test rows and 97 reaction specifications. Results there may be quoted as hypothesis generation only, never as validated forecasts.
